Author: Rhys
Name: Crystal Ledger
Description: Reads what your character owns while you play (collections the Lodestone doesn't show, currencies, bags, saddlebag, armoury, and each retainer once you open them at a bell) and uploads it to your own Crystal Market Ledger site with your private key. Nothing is sent anywhere else.
Punchline: Sends your collections, bags, retainers and desynthesis skill to your Crystal Market Ledger site.
